sections.title: Performance Audit — cadence-lane-2
sections.content: Good news: this codebase already went through two rounds of perf hardening (2026-07-09 baseline, fully fixed by 2026-07-12), so I scoped this fresh pass to areas those rounds didn't touch. The `ecc:performance-optimizer` agent found only **4 new issues** — the repo is genuinely clean, not padded to a round number.

sections.title: 1. N+1 sequential DB writes — HIGH impact
2. Undebounced external-API search — HIGH impact
3. Unconditional 60fps render loop — MEDIUM impact
4. Unmemoized recompute on a polling component — LOW-MEDIUM impact
Confirmed clean (no action needed)
sections.content:
- `src/lib/ai/cache.server.ts` — solid SHA-256 content-hash response cache already in place
- `src/lib/rag/retriever.server.ts` — batched ANN + keyword fallback, MMR rerank, no N+1
- `src/lib/lineage.functions.ts` `getProvenance` BFS — already groups by kind + `.in()` per level
- `OpportunityQueue.tsx`/`OpportunityRow.tsx` — `React.memo` + stable `useCallback`, no cascade re-renders
- Every other `setInterval`/RAF site repo-wide has matching cleanup

All 7 items from the 2026-07-09 baseline (interval leaks, undebounced search elsewhere, sequential insert/upsert, unmemoized sorts, sequential BFS, unmemoized draw-loop label) remain fixed — verified live, not re-reported. I saved both audits to memory (`project_perf-audit-2026-07-12.md`) so a future pass can jump straight to fixes instead of re-scanning.
